## Input specifications for functions and parameters

### Functions 

Functions are grouped by model process and defined in rows in a "Function table", which can have the following columns: 

  * fid -  unique integer id used as a shorthand to refer to a specific function definition
  * Function - function name
  * Type - name identifying "subprocess" the function applies to 
  * TimeFrame - tibble defining years and seasons the function applies to
  * Fleet - the fleet the function applies to
  * PopDims - tibble with population dimensions (less size, `z`) the function applies to
  * Label - character string with underscores representing spaces to be used as a label

"fid" is a unique integer identifying the function and used as a shorthand. Negative fid's indicate the function and its associated parameters are being "mirrored" to the function defined by the positive value. "Type" can be used to distinguish related classes of functions (e.g., "sel" and "ret" to distinguish selectivity and retention functions)."Fleet" can be used to specify identify a specific fleet the function should be applied to. For a given process, not all columns listed above may be necessary. 

#### Examples 

##### selectivity and/or retention functions

```{r}
##--fishery selectivity and retention functions
str = paste0("
fid  function      type  label
1   sel_logistic    sel  TCF_selectivity
2   sel_dbl_normal3 sel  SCF_male_selectivity
3   sel_logistic    sel  SCF_female_selectivity
4   sel_logistic    ret  TCF_male_retention_(start-2004)
5   sel_logistic    ret  TCF_male_retention_(2005-end)
")
tblSelFcns = readr::read_csv(str |> whitespace_groups_to_commas(),progress=FALSE,show_col_types=FALSE)
cap = "tblSelFcns, a `tibble` describing selectivity and retention functions used in the model."
kableExtra::kbl(tblSelFcns,booktabs=TRUE,longtable=TRUE,caption=cap);
```


### Parameters 

Parameters are mapped to functions through the latter's fid.

```{r}
##--set up model dimensions
dim_y = 1948:2025;
dim_s = 1:7;
dim_f = c("TCF","SCF");
dim_x = c("M","F");
dim_m = c("imm","mat")
dim_c = c("ns","os");
dim_zc = seq(25,185,5); #--size cutpoints
dim_zb = calcBinCenters(dim_zc);
dimsYS = tidyr::expand_grid(y=dim_y,s=dim_s);
dimsF  = tidyr::expand_grid(f=dim_f);
dimsPD = tidyr::expand_grid(x=dim_x,m=dim_m,c=dim_c,z=dim_zb);
##--set up various frames
lstMFs = list();
lstMFs$tblYS_TCF = dplyr::bind_rows(
                    tibble::tibble(y=1948:1980,s=3,yf=1), #--time block 1
                    tibble::tibble(y=1981:1990,s=3,yf=2), #--time block 2
                    tibble::tibble(y=1991:2025,s=3,yf=3)  #--time block 3
                   );
cap = "Head of tblYS_TCF, a model frame describing time blocks related to TCF."
kableExtra::kbl(lstMFs$tblYS_TCF |> head(),booktabs=TRUE,longtable=TRUE,caption=cap);
lstMFs$tblYS_SCF = dplyr::bind_rows(
                    tibble::tibble(y=1948:1990,s=3,yf=1), #--time block 1
                    tibble::tibble(y=1991:1996,s=3,yf=2), #--time block 2
                    tibble::tibble(y=1996:2025,s=3,yf=3)  #--time block 3
                   );
cap = "Head of tblYS_SCF, a model frame describing time blocks related to SCF."
kableExtra::kbl(lstMFs$tblYS_TCF |> head(),booktabs=TRUE,longtable=TRUE,caption=cap);
lstMFs$tblPDs_x      = tidyr::expand_grid(x=dim_x);
lstMFs$tblPDs_male   = lstMFs$tblPDs_x |> dplyr::filter(x=="M");
lstMFs$tblPDs_female = lstMFs$tblPDs_x |> dplyr::filter(x=="F");
str = paste0("
fid  pid  param    timeFrames fleets  popDims        FEs      ECs    REs    label
1     1    z50     tblYS_TCF   TCF   tblPDs_x       ~0+yf:x  NA      NA     TCF_sel_z50
1     2    width   tblYS_TCF   TCF   tblPDs_male    ~0+yf    NA      (y|yf) TCF_sel_width_males
1     3    width   tblYS_TCF   TCF   tblPDs_female  ~0+yf    NA      NA     TCF_sel_width_females
2     1  asc_width tblYS_SCF   SCF   tblPDs_male    ~0+yf    NA      NA     sel_ascending_width_SCF_males
2     2     mode   tblYS_SCF   SCF   tblPDs_male    ~0+yf    NA      NA     sel_mode_width_SCF_males
2     3  dsc_width tblYS_SCF   SCF   tblPDs_male    ~0+yf    NA      NA     sel_descending_width_SCF_males
3     1    z50     tblYS_SCF   SCF   tblPDs_female  ~0+yf    NA      NA     sel_z50_SCF_females
3     2    width   tblYS_SCF   SCF   tblPDs_female  ~0+yf    NA      NA     sel_width_SCF_females
4     1    z50     tblYS_retZ1 TCF   tblPDs_male    ~0+yf    NA      NA     ret_z50_TCF_males
4     2    width   tblYS_retW1 TCF   tblPDs_male    ~0+yf    NA      NA     ret_width_TCF_males
5     1    z50     tblYS_retZ2 TCF   tblPDs_male    ~0+yf    NA      NA     ret_z50_TCF_males
5    -2    width   tblYS_retW1 TCF   tblPDs_male    ~0+yf    NA      NA     ret_width_TCF_males_mirrored
")
tblSelPars = readr::read_csv(str |> whitespace_groups_to_commas(),progress=FALSE,show_col_types=FALSE);
cap = "tblSelPars, a model frame describing selectivity parameters."
kableExtra::kbl(tblSelPars,booktabs=TRUE,longtable=TRUE,caption=cap);
```
